investigations.title: Offscreen windsock shadow scheduling
investigations.reachability: Normal projected-shadow path, conditional on visible source, cue/light and changing accepted pose/clock.
investigations.source_finding: Moving socks receive a 512-square target with MSAA disabled. Changed pose/clock invalidates the projector signature. Source/tree visibility is checked, but receiver-frustum visibility is not. Pinned UPDATE_ONCE scheduling does not require render_target_was_used.
existing_guards: Projected policy and illumination govern shown state.
Near-zero inflation suppresses clock-only flutter.
Unchanged/frozen poses reuse the mask.
Release-when-hidden, source lifetime and bounds/signature checks already exist.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Defer mask updates only while the receiver cannot be seen by any relevant consumer; retain newest accepted pose and refresh before first visible use.
acceptance_checks: Actual target draws and timing, separately from request count.
Low sun, offscreen caster with onscreen receiver, reentry, zoom and camera cuts.
Pause/replay and multiple consumers; unchanged physics and accepted clock.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Path inactive or few eligible offscreen updates; no repeatable timing saving; stale visible shadow.

investigations.title: Independent aircraft-shadow MSAA
investigations.reachability: Enabled aircraft cue with a nonempty installed shape; auxiliary settings are independent of root settings.
investigations.source_finding: The aircraft call uses the default 256-square target with MSAA_4X. The receiver applies its own softening samples. Root MSAA disabled does not override this argument.
existing_guards: Cue-off defers binding; empty shape retains legacy mask.
Pose, part-transform and visibility signatures already suppress unchanged draws.
Qualified aircraft proxy is already implemented.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Compare target-specific 4x, 2x and disabled MSAA while preserving main view settings.
acceptance_checks: Thin-wing, propeller/gear, motion and zoom silhouettes.
Height cue and low-sun visual acceptance.
Auxiliary GPU cost and allocation; do not infer 4x fragment invocations.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Negligible saving, shimmer, silhouette loss, or changed grounding cue.

investigations.title: Treeline spatial batching
investigations.reachability: Stock field with Low/Medium detailed-tree angle zero; actual submitted instances depend on camera.
investigations.source_finding: Stock positions total 1680 (480 <=600 m, 1200 >600 m), merged into eight nonempty near-plus-far sector batches with wind-expanded AABBs. MultiMesh visibility is whole-batch.
existing_guards: Already instanced and alpha scissored.
Detailed High trees already use 256-m cells.
Collision selection is independent of visual presets.
Near prefix supports horizon capture and tests; exactly 600 m has near-prefix/far-alpha boundary semantics.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Compare existing eight sectors against separate near/far sectors or bounded grid, with identical scenery and materials.
acceptance_checks: Submitted instances, draw calls, CPU culling and GPU timing on matched views.
Wind bounds, skyline, placement, collision invariance and capture prefix consumers.
Preserve exactly-600-m shader treatment.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Additional culling/draw CPU cost exceeds saving or no significant invisible submission exists.

investigations.title: Uniform grass anchor and optional parcel distance arithmetic
investigations.priority: first shader investigation; parcel idea secondary
investigations.reachability: Anchor only in pilot pin region; shared by ground, near grass and lake bank. Parcel is a guarded far-distance path.
investigations.source_finding: Three noise octaves at uniform pilot_xz are expressed in the fragment include under pin != 1. Parcel compares nine distances to keep two nearest.
existing_guards: Anchor already excluded outside pin region.
Shader compiler may already optimize uniform arithmetic.
Parcel has a nonzero-weight/distance guard.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Compute a render-only anchor per pilot/material recipe; separately compare squared-distance selection followed by two square roots for parcel finalists.
acceptance_checks: GPU-float precision and image parity, translated/negative coordinates, pin boundaries and all grass consumers.
Correct material copies and invalidation; no simulation feedback.
For parcel, preserve ties and border width; inspect actual active shader cost.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Compiler already removes cost, float differences break appearance, or far path is absent from slow phase.

investigations.title: Derivative-safe terrain relief rectangle rejection
investigations.reachability: Relief enabled, within default 80-m end and footprint/distance gate; default field has two eligible rectangles.
investigations.source_finding: Relief evaluates masks for configured rectangles up to capacity 32; unlike the colour loop it lacks a bounds guard. Stock field has only runway and rotorpad eligible.
existing_guards: Enabled, distance and footprint gates already limit relief.
Colour loop already has union and rectangle guards.
Required derivatives are already evaluated before relevant branches.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Skip only provably zero masks and gradients using conservative rectangle bounds.
acceptance_checks: Preserve ordered overlaps, cubic feather, signed-zero/rounding edges and runway/rotorpad precedence.
Keep derivatives outside divergent control flow.
Compare normals and valid translated/custom layouts; separate two-rectangle stock from larger custom fields.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Extra branch/divergence outweighs two-rectangle saving or boundaries differ.

investigations.title: Ground detail texture packing
investigations.reachability: Default field configures photo detail independently of enhanced near grass; active only at positive photo weight.
investigations.source_finding: Two UVs each sample albedo, normal and roughness, yielding six textureGrad expressions on the active path.
existing_guards: Distance and footprint fades already restrict sampling.
Existing import formats, compression and mipmaps are not missing.
Low alone does not remove the default-field binding.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Evaluate a linear normal-RG plus roughness map, keeping albedo colour space separate, to reduce six source sampling expressions to four.
acceptance_checks: Normal reconstruction/precision and compression tradeoffs.
Mip/filter/UV/export parity and source provenance.
Close, grazing and fade-band imagery; timing on existing Intel.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Format cost or register pressure offsets fewer expressions; visible normal or roughness degradation.

investigations.title: Foliage mask channel storage
investigations.reachability: Treeline mask sampling; source and runtime import contracts must remain qualified.
investigations.source_finding: The shader uses the mask red channel. Source assets intentionally retain lossless RGBA8 with atlas-matching alpha at every mip.
existing_guards: Textures already have mipmaps.
Lossless and matching-alpha rules are intentional.
Mask shares atlas UVs and carries fractional edge coverage.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Investigate a deliberate one-channel runtime representation with unchanged validated source assets and sampled values.
acceptance_checks: Preserve every mip, linear mask values, coverage, far-alpha compensation and foliage-only tint.
Measure source texture lifetime plus conversion/readback peak, not only destination bytes.
Do not break existing RGBA8 alpha validation without equivalent deliberate contract work.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Both old and new textures remain resident, conversion peak harms loading, or foliage/coverage changes.

investigations.title: Early tree alpha rejection
investigations.reachability: Actual treeline shader variants and applicable passes; alpha scissor already enabled.
investigations.source_finding: Pinned GLES3 inserts custom fragment code before generated scissor discard; the custom code samples/tints first. RENDER_MATERIAL uses different alpha semantics.
existing_guards: Already uses alpha scissor, not ordinary alpha blending.
Compiler can reorder/optimize; overdraw is not measured.
Derivative and engine pass contracts constrain manual discard.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Measure overdraw then compare an early atlas-alpha reject before remaining mask/shading, with gradients prepared before divergence.
acceptance_checks: All applicable material/depth variants and generated code.
Leaf edges, wind, mips, silhouettes and far compensation.
CPU/GPU timing and depth/SIMD effects.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Discard breaks pass behavior or derivative validity, harms depth efficiency, or costs more than it saves.

investigations.title: Compatibility sky arithmetic and supported pass structure
investigations.reachability: Visible sky colour transform plus separately scheduled radiance and cloud cache consumers.
investigations.source_finding: Compatibility colour encoding contains pow plus three Newton steps. Pinned GLES3 recognizes reduced-resolution sky flags but does not schedule half/quarter passes.
existing_guards: Incremental radiance and cloud-drift throttling already exist; other appearance edits can refresh.
Cloud cache already avoids some analytic work.
Density-bound experiments already exist, are off by default and have prior strict numerical failures.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Measure bounded colour approximation or iteration reduction; optionally reevaluate existing density-bound variants with their original gates.
acceptance_checks: Night/twilight/bright sun and horizon/fog/radiance consistency.
Numerical and moving-cloud imagery; no generic sRGB replacement.
Treat visible background, radiance and cache bake separately.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Unsupported mode, colour/numerical regression or no measurable cost reduction.

investigations.title: Lake probe refresh coalescing
investigations.reachability: Only an installed and actually used lake reflection probe; GL support exists but actual activity is unmeasured.
investigations.source_finding: UPDATE_ONCE probe is nudged on changed water-lighting signature; ordinary world lighting updates already step at 30 sky seconds. Pinned GL contains a reflection-probe rendering path.
existing_guards: Signature skips unchanged captures.
Normal lighting cadence is 1.5 flight seconds at x20, not every frame.
Explicit sky-edit refresh and Compatibility night-ambient handling already exist.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Count actual probe activity, then coalesce refreshes only while no visible reflective consumer requires them.
acceptance_checks: All reflective consumers and masks, reentry freshness, paused edits and changing sun/night.
Actual capture time separate from requested refreshes.
Treat signature serialization as CPU work; parameter getters are not evidence of GPU readback.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Probe absent/inactive, other visible consumers need freshness or reflected scene pops.

investigations.title: Transmitter static/dynamic draw separation
investigations.reachability: Pilot transmitter visible and control input changes; identical inputs already skip redraw.
investigations.source_finding: Changed controls redraw one CanvasItem containing static artwork and moving gimbals; LCD display can change on a separate useful cadence.
existing_guards: Unchanged inputs are already filtered.
Godot caches draw commands between redraws.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Separate static artwork, dynamic controls and displayed LCD-value invalidation without reducing input responsiveness.
acceptance_checks: Command-build CPU time and draw calls for still, moving and noisy controls.
Trim/mode/model updates, resizing/scaling and pixel parity.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Extra CanvasItems/draw calls outweigh rebuilding or CPU effect is negligible.

investigations.title: Invisible afterimage presentation work
investigations.reachability: Perspective eye-view path with valid camera/sky, including an inactive/rested afterimage.
investigations.source_finding: Eight patch records, packed arrays and two setters are prepared before deciding whether any alpha exceeds 0.002.
existing_guards: Camera/sky guards already exist.
Afterimage state follows the accepted simulation clock.
Setter calls do not establish a GPU upload or barrier each call.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Decide visibility before presentation-array preparation, while advancing state and diagnostics and publishing a complete payload before reappearance.
acceptance_checks: Inactive versus active allocation/CPU counts.
Exposure threshold, cloud/skyline, recovery, eyewear and camera-mode transitions.
Pause/replay; retain diagnostic metadata and state evolution.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: No measurable CPU saving or skipped state causes incorrect recovery/first visible frame.

investigations.title: Cloud bake texture round trip
investigations.reachability: Bounded cache miss or seed/owner transition; not a steady every-frame bake.
investigations.source_finding: A 2048-square HDR viewport bake is read after three process frames, validated at 16 seed-specific points, converted to RGH and uploaded to an ImageTexture. Desktop GL readback uses client-memory glGetTexImage; fallback uses glReadPixels.
existing_guards: At most four entries including pending/failed; at most two attempts.
Weak consumers, generation tokens, rebind-before-evict, release and analytic fallback already exist.
Sky can retain a tile with ground shadows off.
Process-frame delay is not evidence of a measured GPU fence.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Compare validated 1024/2048 tiles or stagger owned completions; larger optional design retains GPU output with smaller validation transfer.
acceptance_checks: First-use and steady-state timing kept separate.
Validation, seed/lifetime/capacity/fallback and moving-cloud image parity.
Peak staging/render-target/image memory; four final logical tiles alone are 64 MiB.
PBO must avoid immediate wait; no unimplemented RenderingDevice drop-in assumption.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Cache already warm, no attributed readback stall, memory grows or numerical/image parity fails.

investigations.title: Mesh extraction before worker and expanded geometry memory
investigations.reachability: ArrayMesh surface snapshots and geometry cache misses; Home night-layout path is conditional.
investigations.source_finding: Pinned ArrayMesh extraction reaches GLES3 buffer mapping with GL_MAP_READ_BIT and copies before worker computation. A 3-ms snapshot budget is checked between indivisible surface reads. Worker expands indices to triangle vertices.
existing_guards: 96-MiB input count already exists but is not a peak-allocation cap.
Authored light anchors, bounded caches and cancellation already exist.
Mesh.get_faces has a valid triangle_mesh cache; not every call rereads GPU data.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Reuse compact derived geometry/layout with revision/pose keys inside bounded ownership; investigate indexed worker processing without full triangle expansion.
acceptance_checks: Read count for first use and cache hits; maximum main-thread chunk and peak memory.
Anchors, caster filters, articulation and triangle-strip fallback.
Livery/revision invalidation, worker ownership and cancellation; layout parity.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Extraction already cached, allocation not material, invalidation incorrect or output changes.

investigations.title: First Home construction and deliberate warmup
investigations.reachability: First Home and conditional aircraft/crash setup; cold and warm population must be separate.
investigations.source_finding: First Home calls synchronous finish_construction/show_aircraft after resource/world stages. Later selection has phased broker work. Compatibility crash warmup explicitly draws twice without/with extra Omni fire light; directional sun may be present in both.
existing_guards: Flight joins only after worker completion.
Home resource retrieval checks status and uses a two-resource LRU.
Later Home uses three-model cache and phased work.
Gearless placement scans are conditional; warmup exists to avoid later crash stalls.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Attribute resource, validation/build, geometry, image work, warmup and first draw, then stage accepted construction or reuse derived data without weakening validation.
acceptance_checks: Cold versus warm phase spans, first visible use and crash behavior.
Thread/scene ownership and warmup variant coverage.
Latest intent, cancellation, livery and bounded cache behavior.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Stall merely moves later, unsafe threading or lost coverage/validation.

investigations.title: Lighting-skin retrieval guard and bounded intermediate reuse
investigations.reachability: Supported aircraft and enabled lighting-skin zones/materials; not baseline every-frame work.
investigations.source_finding: get_image occurs before the 2048 input-dimension guard. Cache key includes texture plus tint. Accepted sources are converted, sampled into a 512-square mask, mipped and uploaded.
existing_guards: Per-rig composition cache, aircraft/material/zone selection and target caps already exist.
Editor texture image cache may alter extraction cost.
Ground deliberately shares cached bytes rather than mutable per-world textures.
investigations.proposed_experiment: Where metadata represents actual stored size, reject early; share source-image/tint-independent work within a bounded configuration operation.
acceptance_checks: Texture size overrides, accepted/oversized sources and enabled-feature timing.
Colour/UV/mips and livery/material isolation.
Source lifetime and peak memory; ImageTexture.update only with matching format/dimensions/mips and ownership.
investigations.falsifier_or_deprioritization: Feature absent, metadata size is misleading, shared texture mutation leaks, or no saving.

stock_tree_census.method: Raw positions.value, atan2(east,north) modulo tau / (tau/8), radius <= 600.
stock_tree_census.limit: Source placements and grouping, not observed GPU submission or wasted work.

stock_relief_rectangles.limit: Runtime field identity and enabled path must be recorded.

cloud_final_tile.limit: Logical final texture payload without mips; excludes staging, render targets, transient images and allocator overhead. Four cache entries include pending/failed, not always four ready tiles.

photo_detail.limit: Source expressions only, not hardware taps, bandwidth reduction or measured performance.

snapshot_input.limit: Accounting excludes concurrent engine arrays/copies/transformed points; budget checks occur between indivisible surface reads.

review.status: passed; no blocking findings after integrated corrections
corrections_already_integrated: Requests are not GPU completions; pinned UPDATE_ONCE eligibility adds evidence but no timing.
Windsock 512-square MSAA-off is distinct from aircraft 256-square MSAA4x.
Default relief has two rectangles, not maximum 32; lower priority.
Treeline prefix, exact-600-m alpha boundary, wind bounds and collision remain protected.
Grass include has ground, near-grass and lake-bank consumers.
Cloud cache is bounded, validated and first-use; logical final bytes are not peak residency.
Mesh get_faces caches triangles; only relevant cache-miss extraction follows GL buffer readback.
Crash warmup toggles extra Omni light; first draw can already contain directional sun.
Runtime R8 conversion must price the original RGBA source and transition peak, not only destination bytes.
